stories.title: WR Chase's fiery halftime speech inspires Bengals' turnaround vs. Ravens
stories.summary: Ja'Marr Chase unloaded on his Bengals teammates in a halftime speech that inspired Cincinnati to a comeback victory over the Ravens.

stories.title: Jets WR Wilson says sideline screaming wasn't directed at QB Smith
stories.summary: Garrett Wilson said he was just expressing frustration after cameras caught the Jets star WR screaming on the sideline during a disappointing loss to Miami.

stories.title: 'Remarkable' return: Daniels seals Falcons win with INT week after scary injury
stories.summary: Kendal Daniels had the game-sealing interception to help the Falcons beat the 49ers one week after he was immobilized by medical personnel.

stories.title: 'We're not far off,' O'Connell says as Vikings reach 6-0 despite lagging offense
stories.summary: As his offense continued to grind Sunday at historically low levels for an undefeated team, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell had a simple message: "We're not far off."

stories.title: Colts' Steichen says he's not mulling a QB change despite Jones' struggles
stories.summary: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Sunday he hasn't thought about a quarterback change following Daniel Jones' struggles.
